answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable basalt bond before it can trade: the bond is locked at a single verified vertex of its work history, so one operator cannot spin up thousands of free clones. Peers attest only identities whose past jobs check out, and a bad actor loses its bond instead of merely creating a new name. Honest work earns the bond back plus a small fee, so the cost of a ripple of fake identities quickly exceeds any gain from flooding the market with sybils.
